meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: Claude 会把 Teams 适配器复制进 src/channels/ 并注册,安装 @chat-adapter/teams@4.29.0,构建后跑注册测试;再引导你登录 Teams CLI、创建机器人、把凭据写进 .env 并装进 Teams。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 Microsoft Teams(团队频道、群聊、私聊)时触发。若 .env 里已有任一 Teams 凭据,创建步骤会被跳过,直接进入重启。

say.text: 帮我把 Teams 机器人建好并接进来。
say.note: 会引导登录 Teams CLI、创建机器人并写入 .env。

say.text: 把助手接到我的 Teams 账号上,让它先给我发消息。
say.note: 会创建 bot↔owner 的 1:1 会话并确认接线目标。

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Teams adapter into src/channels/, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/teams@4.29.0, builds and tests it, then walks you through Teams CLI sign-in, creating the bot, .env credentials, and installing the app.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Microsoft Teams channel to NanoClaw. If .env already holds a Teams credential, the creation steps are skipped and the flow goes straight to Restart.

say_en.text: Add a Microsoft Teams channel to this project via the Chat SDK bridge.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dep, runs the test.

say_en.text: Set up the Teams bot and connect it for me.
say_en.note: Guides Teams CLI sign-in, bot create, .env.

say_en.text: Wire the assistant to my Teams account so it messages me first.
